# apple_app_store_version_experiments (Data Source)

Lists an app's product page optimization experiments.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "apple_app_store_version_experiments" "running" {
  app_id = data.apple_app.example.id
  states = ["APPROVED"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the app.

### Optional

- `states` (Set of String) States to match: `PREPARE_FOR_SUBMISSION`, `READY_FOR_REVIEW`, `WAITING_FOR_REVIEW`, `IN_REVIEW`, `ACCEPTED`, `APPROVED`, `REJECTED`, `COMPLETED`, `STOPPED`. Values: `PREPARE_FOR_SUBMISSION`, `READY_FOR_REVIEW`, `WAITING_FOR_REVIEW`, `IN_REVIEW`, `ACCEPTED`, `APPROVED`, `REJECTED`, `COMPLETED`, `STOPPED`.

### Read-Only

- `experiments` (Attributes List) The experiments. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--experiments))

<a id="nestedatt--experiments"></a>
### Nested Schema for `experiments`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the experiment.
- `name` (String) Reference name of the test.
- `platform` (String) Platform of the product page.
- `state` (String) State of the experiment.
- `traffic_proportion` (Number) Percentage of visitors who see a treatment.
